metadata.label: GPT6-1
metadata.research_question: What reusable maintenance concerns and evidence qualifications are expressed by the supplied ML-project code comments and their source context?
metadata.analysis_method: Direct assistant reading of all supplied sections, per-artifact notes, inductive consolidation and manually authored assignments; scripts only package and validate the analysis.
metadata.label_note: GPT6-1 is the user-requested output label; it does not attest to a separately invoked model endpoint.
metadata.scope: The supplied comment and retrieved source excerpts, not entire repositories or executed behavior. All artifacts are coded; evidence-qualification codes do not assert a technical-debt defect.
limitations: Source-context ambiguity and historical revision limitations remain in evidence and scope notes.
Questions, proposals, implemented workarounds, and confirmed mismatches are distinguished in case rationales.
This is one assistant analysis, not independent human validation or two independent coding runs.
